newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-PM SHKELE TALKS OF RESIGNATION-REPORTS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-PM SHKELE TALKS OF RESIGNATION-REPORTS.

text.p: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele has said the resignation of his government is possible, newspapers said on Thursday.

The newspapers said the fall of the government was possible after Shkele lost four ministers to corruption scandals, amid a row over Transport Minister Vilis Krishtopans, who has refused to resign, and due to a scandal over a loan of three million lats by Banka Baltiya to state energy supplier Latvenergo.
"One could talk about such things," Shkele was quoted as saying when asked if the government crisis was so deep that it would force the government to resign.
Shkele was speaking after he returned to Latvia from Britain, where he was on holiday learning English.
Krishtopans refused to resign although the prosecutor's office said he broke anti-corruption laws.
Krishtopans' party, Latvia's Way, has said it will leave the government if Shkele makes Krishtopans quit.
